# Which of your Actions jobs leave the token in .git/config?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every actions/checkout step without persist-credentials: false, with jobs that also upload artifacts (the artipacked pattern) listed first. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
